title: Code for: Chromatin topology and distal elements underlie divergent cell type-specific regulation of 9p21 locus cell cycle genes
description: Analysis code accompanying Torlai Triglia, Miller et al. Includes single-cell RNA-seq quantification of p16INK4A/p14ARF, GTEx/FANTOM tissue expression, Region Capture Micro-C and loop calling, ATAC-seq differential accessibility, CRISPRa screen (SCEPTRE) analysis, ChromBPNet attribution, and IGV session files for the 9p21 locus. Raw and processed data are available at GEO GSE309515.
